source_tables.table_title: Schedule of Events for Protocol H2Q-MC-LZZT(c)
source_tables.table_purpose: Primary schedule of events for protocol H2Q-MC-LZZT(c): all study activities against visits 1-13 plus Early Termination and Retrieval encounters.

property_hierarchy.property_comment: Visit identifiers running across the two horizontally tiled column blocks: numbered visits 1-5, an unlabelled column, 7-13, then the named encounters ET (Early Termination) and RT (Retrieval). Classified 'visit' because the values are visit identifiers, not days or weeks. The label 'VISIT' is printed in the narrow second label column.

Study week for each visit column (-2, -.3, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 26). Classified 'week' because the values are week numbers relative to randomization at Week 0. The ET and RT columns carry no week value; the unlabelled column (position 8) carries none either. Label 'WEEK' printed in the narrow second label column, on the same printed row as the activity-column heading 'ACTIVITY'.

unified_annotations.annotation_text: Xa = Performed at this visit if patient is an insulin-dependent diabetic.
Xb = Performed at this visit and via telephone interview 2 weeks following this visit.

P = Practice only - It is recommended that a sampling of the CIBIC+, ADAS-Cog, DAD, and NPI-X be administered at Visit 1. Data from this sampling would not be considered as study data and would not be collected.
